sql: select o.strategy, o.market_ticker, o.quantity, o.limit_price, o.status, o.created_at, (select count(*) from live_orders k where k.strategy='Kmmsell10' and k.market_ticker=o.market_ticker) k_orders from live_orders o where o.strategy in ('Jmmsell10','Fmmsell10') and o.status in ('resting','pending','submitted','partial') order by created_at
